core_obligations: Reduce by the criterion to showing that the trace of a retrocompact open is retrocompact in the closed subset (proof lines 2880-2882)
Adjoin the complement of the closed subset to a quasi-compact open of it, obtaining a quasi-compact open of the space with the same trace (proof lines 2883-2886)
Conclude: the trace is closed inside the intersection of that open with the retrocompact open, hence quasi-compact (proof lines 2887-2889)
proof_roadmap: 由构造性判据，只需证 V ∩ Z 在 Z 中 retrocompact。
对 Z 中的准紧开 W，令 W' = W ∪ (X ∖ Z)：它准紧、开，且 Z ∩ W' = W。
V ∩ Z ∩ W = V ∩ Z ∩ W' 是准紧开 V ∩ W' 的闭子集 ⇒ 准紧。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the intersection of a constructible subset with a closed subset is constructible in that closed subset (author lemma at source lines 2872-2878, label lemma-intersect-constructible-with-closed). The proof (source lines 2880-2890) reduces to retrocompactness of the trace of a retrocompact open, adjoins the complement of the closed subset to a quasi-compact open so that the trace is unchanged, and uses closedness inside a quasi-compact open (proof lines 2880-2889). The adjoining step is the substance. H3.
